local function normalizeId(raw)
    raw = (raw or ""):gsub("%s+", "")
    if raw == "" then return nil end
    if tonumber(raw) then
        return "rbxassetid://" .. raw
    end
    if raw:match("^rbxassetid://") then return raw end
    if raw:match("^https?://") then
        local id = raw:match("(%d+)")
        if id then return "rbxassetid://" .. id end
    end
    return raw
end

    s.Name = "BoomboxSound"
    s.Looped = state.looped
    s.Volume = state.volume
    s.PlaybackSpeed = state.speed
    s.Pitch = state.pitch
    s.Parent = SoundService
    state.sound = s
    return s
end

local function stopSound()
    if state.sound then
        state.sound:Stop()
        state.sound:Destroy()
        state.sound = nil
    end
    state.playing = false
end

local function playSound()
    if state.soundId == "" then
        setStatus("Enter a music id first.")
        return
    end
    stopSound()
    local s = ensureSound()
    s.SoundId = state.soundId
    s.Volume = state.volume
    s.PlaybackSpeed = state.speed
    s.Pitch = state.pitch
    s.Looped = state.looped
    local ok, err = pcall(function() s:Play() end)
    if not ok then
        setStatus("Playback failed.")
        return
    end
    state.playing = true
    setStatus("Playing.")
end

local function pauseSound()
    if state.sound and state.playing then
        state.sound:Pause()
        state.playing = false
        setStatus("Paused.")
    end

    if state.sound and not state.playing then

-- true if this belongs to a player or an NPC/animal (anything with a Humanoid)
local function isLiving(inst)
    local cached = npcCache[inst]
    if cached ~= nil then return cached end
    local result = false
    -- player characters (yours and others')
    if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(inst) or inst:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model") and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(inst:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model")) then
        result = true
    end
    local char = lp.Character
    if char and (inst == char or inst:IsDescendantOf(char)) then result = true end
    -- NPCs, animals, pets, followers: anything rigged or animated
    local m = inst:IsA("Model") and inst or inst:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    local depth = 0
    while not result and m and m ~= workspace and depth < 6 do
        if m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            or m:FindFirstChildOfClass("AnimationController")
            or m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Motor6D", true)
            or m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animator", true) then
            result = true
            break
        end
        m = m:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
        depth += 1
    end
    -- things attached to or chasing a character (pets, companions)
    if not result then
        local parts = inst:IsA("BasePart") and { inst } or inst:GetDescendants()
        for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                for _, j in ipairs(p:GetJoints()) do
                    local other = (j.Part0 == p) and j.Part1 or j.Part0
                    if other and other:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
                        and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(other:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")) then
                        result = true
                        break
                    end
                end
                if p:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("AlignPosition") or p:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BodyPosition")
                    or p:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BodyGyro") or p:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("AlignOrientation") then
                    result = true
                end
            end
            if result then break end
        end
    end
    npcCache[inst] = result
    return result
end

local function isMovable(d)
    if d:IsA("BasePart") then
        return (S.includeAnchored or not d.Anchored) and d.Size.Magnitude <= MAX_ITEM_SIZE
    end
    if d:GetExtentsSize().Magnitude > MAX_ITEM_SIZE then return false end
    if S.includeAnchored then return true end
    for _, p in ipairs(d:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") and not p.Anchored then return true end
    end
    return false
end

-- if a parent Model already matches, we move that Model instead of its parts
local function ancestorModelMatches(d, matcher)
    local m = d.Parent
    while m and m ~= workspace do
        if m:IsA("Model") and matcher(m.Name) then return true end
        m = m.Parent
    end
    return false
end

local function itemPosition(d)
    return d:IsA("Model") and d:GetPivot().Position or d.Position
end

-- extra text a game may use to label an item (ProximityPrompt text, Attributes)
local labelCache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local function labelText(d)
    local cached = labelCache[d]
    if cached then return cached end
    local parts = {}
    for _, c in ipairs(d:GetChildren()) do
        if c:IsA("ProximityPrompt") or c:IsA("ClickDetector") then
            if c:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
                parts[#parts + 1] = c.ObjectText
                parts[#parts + 1] = c.ActionText
            end
        elseif c:IsA("StringValue") then
            parts[#parts + 1] = c.Value
        end
    end
    for _, key in ipairs({ "ItemName", "Item", "Name", "DisplayName", "Type" }) do
        local v = d:GetAttribute(key)
        if type(v) == "string" then parts[#parts + 1] = v end
    end
    local text = table.concat(parts, " ")
    labelCache[d] = text
    return text
end

local function isVisible(d)
    if d:IsA("BasePart") then return d.Transparency < 0.9 end
    for _, p in ipairs(d:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Transparency < 0.9 then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function isCandidate(d, matcher, hrpPos)
    if moved[d] then return false end
    if EXCLUDED[d.Name:lower()] then return false end
    if not (matcher(d.Name) or matcher(labelText(d))) then return false end
    if isLiving(d) then return false end
    if ancestorModelMatches(d, matcher) then return false end
    if not isMovable(d) then return false end
    if not isVisible(d) then return false end
    if (itemPosition(d) - hrpPos).Magnitude < SKIP_NEAR then return false end
    return true
end

local function moveItem(item, cf)
    return pcall(function()
        if item:IsA("Model") then
            item:PivotTo(cf)
            for _, p in ipairs(item:GetDescendants()) do
                if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                    p.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    p.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                end
            end
        else
            item.CFrame = cf
            item.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            item.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end
    end)
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------
-- INDEX: scan the workspace once, then keep it updated with events,
-- so we never re-walk every descendant on each bring / auto tick.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------
local idxList, idxSet = {}, setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local idxReady, idxBuilding = false, false

local function indexAdd(d)
    if (d:IsA("Model") or d:IsA("BasePart")) and not idxSet[d] then
        idxSet[d] = true
        idxList[#idxList + 1] = d
    end
end

workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(indexAdd)

local function ensureIndex()
    if idxReady then return end
    if idxBuilding then
        while not idxReady do task.wait(0.1) end
        return
    end
    idxBuilding = true
    local n = 0
    for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        indexAdd(d)
        n += 1
        if n % 2000 == 0 then task.wait() end
    end
    idxReady, idxBuilding = true, false
end

-- iterate the index in small slices, dropping destroyed instances
local function forEachIndexed(fn)
    ensureIndex()
    local write = 0
    local read = 0
    local total = #idxList
    while read < total do
        read += 1
        local d = idxList[read]
        if d.Parent then
            write += 1
            idxList[write] = d
            if fn(d) == false then
                -- stop early: keep the rest of the list intact
                for i = read + 1, total do
                    write += 1
                    idxList[write] = idxList[i]
                end
                read = total
            end
        end
        if read % 250 == 0 then task.wait() end
    end
    -- anything added while we yielded sits after `total`
    for i = total + 1, #idxList do
        write += 1
        idxList[write] = idxList[i]
    end
    for i = #idxList, write + 1, -1 do idxList[i] = nil end
end

local toCampfire = false
local function findCampfire()
    for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        local n = d.Name:lower()
        if n:find("campfire", 1, true) or n:find("bonfire", 1, true) or n:find("firepit", 1, true) or n:find("fire_pit", 1, true) then
            if d:IsA("BasePart") then return d end
            if d:IsA("Model") then
                local p = d.PrimaryPart or d:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
                if p then return p end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- where items land: next to you, or on top of the campfire
local function getTargetCF(hrp)
    if toCampfire then
        local cf = findCampfire()
        if cf then return cf.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, S.campOffset, 0), true end
    end
    return hrp.CFrame, false
end

local busy = false
local function bring(matcher, cap)
    local hrp = getHRP()
    if not hrp then return 0 end
    local brought = 0

    forEachIndexed(function(d)
        if brought >= cap then return false end
        local ok, good = pcall(isCandidate, d, matcher, hrp.Position)
        if ok and good then
            local base = getTargetCF(hrp)
            local offset = CFrame.new(math.random(-6, 6), 2, math.random(-6, 6))
            if moveItem(d, base * offset) then
                moved[d] = true
                brought += 1
            end
        end
    end)
    return brought
end

-- Brings every chest and lines them up in a grid in front of you
local function bringChestsInFront()
    local hrp = getHRP()
    if not hrp then return 0 end
    local matcher = function(name) return matchesCategory(name, "chests") end
    local hrpPos = hrp.Position

    local found = {}
    forEachIndexed(function(d)
        local ok, good = pcall(isCandidate, d, matcher, hrpPos)
        if ok and good then found[#found + 1] = d end
    end)

    local COLUMNS, SPACING, DISTANCE = 6, 6, 12
    local origin = hrp.CFrame
    local brought = 0
    for i, chest in ipairs(found) do
        local col = (i - 1) % COLUMNS
        local row = math.floor((i - 1) / COLUMNS)
        local x = (col - (COLUMNS - 1) / 2) * SPACING
        local z = -(DISTANCE + row * SPACING)
        -- ground-level spot in front of you, chest turned to face you
        local pos = (origin * CFrame.new(x, -2, z)).Position
        local cf = CFrame.lookAt(pos, Vector3.new(origin.Position.X, pos.Y, origin.Position.Z))
        if moveItem(chest, cf) then
            moved[chest] = true
            brought += 1
        end
        if i % 20 == 0 then task.wait() end
    end
    return brought
end


local function currentCap()
    local c = CAP_OPTIONS[S.capIndex]
    return S.perf and math.min(c, 50) or c
end

-- bring the N closest items of any category
local function bringNearest(count)
    local hrp = getHRP()
    if not hrp then return 0 end
    local matcher = function(name) return matchesCategory(name, "all") end
    local found = {}
    forEachIndexed(function(d)
        local ok, good = pcall(isCandidate, d, matcher, hrp.Position)
        if ok and good then
            found[#found + 1] = { inst = d, dist = (itemPosition(d) - hrp.Position).Magnitude }
        end
    end)
    table.sort(found, function(a, b) return a.dist < b.dist end)
    local brought = 0
    for i = 1, math.min(count, #found) do
        local base = getTargetCF(hrp)
        local offset = CFrame.new(math.random(-6, 6), 2, math.random(-6, 6))
        if moveItem(found[i].inst, base * offset) then
            moved[found[i].inst] = true
            brought += 1
        end
    end
    return brought
end

local function GetTarget()
    local target = nil
    local shortestDist = math.huge
    local screenCenter = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)

    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local humanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position)
                if onScreen then
                    local screenPos = Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y)
                    local dist = (screenPos - screenCenter).Magnitude

                    if getgenv().AimbotMode == "Closest" then
                        if dist < shortestDist then
                            shortestDist = dist
                            target = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                        end
                    elseif getgenv().AimbotMode == "FOV" then
                        if dist <= getgenv().FOVRadius and dist < shortestDist then
                            shortestDist = dist
                            target = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return target
end

        if targetPart then

        end
    end
end)

-- // Delta Executor - Drone com Comando Estilo DJI RC (v3 com Térmico e Bombas)
-- Só toque (telemóvel): joystick esquerdo = altura/girar | joystick direito = mover

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

if Workspace:FindFirstChild("RealisticDroneModel") then Workspace.RealisticDroneModel:Destroy() end

-- Configuração
local SPEED, VSPEED, YAW_SPEED = 40, 25, 2.2

-- Estado

local flying, mode = false, "manual" -- manual | takeoff | rth | follow | land

-- Efeitos extra

local function getHumanoid()
    return character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. Modelo do drone
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local droneModel = Instance.new("Model")
droneModel.Name = "RealisticDroneModel"
droneModel.Parent = Workspace

local dronePart = Instance.new("Part")
dronePart.Name = "DroneCore"
dronePart.Size = Vector3.new(2, 0.6, 2.5)
dronePart.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
dronePart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(55, 60, 65)
dronePart.CanCollide = false
dronePart.Parent = droneModel
droneModel.PrimaryPart = dronePart

-- Raycast para descobrir o chão
local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {droneModel, character}

local function groundY(pos)
    local r = Workspace:Raycast(pos + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), Vector3.new(0, -1000, 0), rayParams)
    return r and r.Position.Y or nil
end

-- Posição inicial: no chão, à frente do jogador
local look = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector
local startPos = rootPart.Position + look * 4
local startGround = groundY(startPos + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0))
yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
dronePart.CFrame = CFrame.new(startPos.X, (startGround or (rootPart.Position.Y - 2.5)) + 0.9, startPos.Z)
    * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)

local function weldTo(p0, p1)
    local w = Instance.new("Weld")
    w.Part0 = p0
    w.Part1 = p1
    w.C0 = p0.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(p1.CFrame)
    w.Parent = p0
    return w
end

local function addPart(size, offset, color, material, shape)
    local p = Instance.new("Part")
    p.Size = size
    p.CFrame = dronePart.CFrame * offset
    p.Color = color
    p.Material = material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
    if shape then p.Shape = shape end
    p.CanCollide = false
    p.Massless = true
    p.Parent = droneModel
    return p, weldTo(dronePart, p)
end

    }, base)
    local knob = make("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 40),
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 235),
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.2,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, base)
    roundify(knob, 20)

    local active
    local function update(p)
        local center = base.AbsolutePosition + base.AbsoluteSize / 2
        local maxR = base.AbsoluteSize.X / 2 - 8
        local delta = Vector2.new(p.X, p.Y) - center
        if delta.Magnitude > maxR then delta = delta.Unit * maxR end
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, delta.X, 0.5, delta.Y)
        callback(Vector2.new(delta.X / maxR, -delta.Y / maxR))
    end
    local function reset()
        active = nil
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
        callback(Vector2.zero)
    end

    base.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            active = input
            update(input.Position)
        end
    end)
    table.insert(conns, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not active then return end
        if input == active
            or (active.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
            update(input.Position)
        end
    end))
    table.insert(conns, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input == active then reset() end
    end))
end

    local target = math.atan2(-v.X, -v.Z)

    yaw = yaw + diff * math.min(1, dt * 4)

local function getInput()

local modeNames = {
    manual = "MANUAL", takeoff = "A DESCOLAR", rth = "REGRESSAR A CASA",
    follow = "A SEGUIR-TE", land = "A ATERRAR",
}
local uiTimer = 0

-- Ciclo principal
table.insert(conns, RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    if not dronePart.Parent then cleanup() return end

    local pos = dronePart.Position
    local gy = groundY(pos)
    local minY = gy and (gy + 0.9) or -math.huge
    local yawIn, vertIn, strafeIn, fwdIn = getInput()
    local inputMag = math.abs(yawIn) + math.abs(vertIn) + math.abs(strafeIn) + math.abs(fwdIn)

    local vel = Vector3.zero
    local tiltF, tiltS = 0, 0

    if flying then
        battery = math.max(0, battery - dt * (0.5 + curVel.Magnitude / 80))
        if battery <= 0 and mode ~= "land" then
            setMode("land")
            toast("🔋 Bateria vazia, a aterrar")
        end
        if inputMag > 0.2 and battery > 0 and (mode == "rth" or mode == "follow" or mode == "land") then
            setMode("manual")
        end

        if mode == "takeoff" then
            vel = Vector3.new(0, 8, 0)
            if pos.Y - (gy or (pos.Y - 3)) >= 3 then setMode("manual") end
        elseif mode == "manual" then
            yaw = yaw - yawIn * dt * YAW_SPEED
            local horiz = CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0):VectorToWorldSpace(
                Vector3.new(strafeIn * SPEED, 0, -fwdIn * SPEED))
            vel = horiz + Vector3.new(0, vertIn * VSPEED, 0)
            tiltF, tiltS = fwdIn, strafeIn
        elseif mode == "rth" then
            local d = homePos() - pos
            local flat = Vector3.new(d.X, 0, d.Z)
            if flat.Magnitude > 3 then
                vel = flat.Unit * math.min(SPEED, flat.Magnitude * 3)
                    + Vector3.new(0, math.clamp(d.Y * 2, -VSPEED, VSPEED), 0)
                faceDir(flat, dt)
                tiltF = 0.6
            else
                setMode("land")
            end
        elseif mode == "follow" then
            local d = followPos() - pos
            vel = d * 3
            if vel.Magnitude > SPEED * 1.1 then vel = vel.Unit * SPEED * 1.1 end
            local toPlayer = rootPart.Position - pos
            faceDir(Vector3.new(toPlayer.X, 0, toPlayer.Z), dt)
        elseif mode == "land" then
            vel = Vector3.new(0, -8, 0)
            if gy and pos.Y <= minY + 0.15 then
                flying = false
                setMode("manual")
                refreshFlyBtn()
                toast("🛬 Aterrou")
            end
        end

        if pos.Y <= minY and vel.Y < 0 then
            vel = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z)
        end
    else
        battery = math.min(100, battery + dt * 3)
    end

    curVel = curVel:Lerp(vel, math.min(1, dt * 5))
    curTiltF = curTiltF + (tiltF - curTiltF) * math.min(1, dt * 6)
    curTiltS = curTiltS + (tiltS - curTiltS) * math.min(1, dt * 6)
    bv.Velocity = curVel
    bg.CFrame = CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(-curTiltF * 0.3, 0, -curTiltS * 0.3)

    local targetRotor = flying and (45 + curVel.Magnitude * 0.5) or 0
    rotorSpeed = rotorSpeed + (targetRotor - rotorSpeed) * math.min(1, dt * 3)
    rotorAngle = rotorAngle + rotorSpeed * dt
    for _, r in ipairs(rotors) do
        r.weld.C0 = r.base * CFrame.Angles(0, rotorAngle * r.dir, 0)
    end

    if cameraAttached then
        local gp = dronePart.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, -0.2, -1.7))
        camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(gp) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
        camera.FieldOfView = fov
    end

    if recording then recTime += dt end

    uiTimer += dt
    if uiTimer >= 0.1 then
        uiTimer = 0
        local alt = gy and (pos.Y - gy) or pos.Y
        local dist = (pos - rootPart.Position).Magnitude
        local zoomX = DEFAULT_FOV / fov
        local bat = math.floor(battery)
        local telemetry = string.format("ALT %dm  VEL %d  DIST %dm\n🔋 %d%%  🔍 x%.1f",
            math.floor(alt), math.floor(curVel.Magnitude), math.floor(dist), bat, zoomX)

        local state = flying and modeNames[mode] or (battery < 100 and "A CARREGAR" or "NO CHÃO")
        screenLabel.Text = "📡 " .. state .. "\n" .. telemetry
        hudTelemetry.Text = telemetry

        local bc = battery > 50 and Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120)
            or battery > 20 and Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 0)
            or Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
        ledStatus.TextColor3 = bc
        ledStatus.Text = string.format("🔋 %d%%  [ DJI RC - LINKED ]", bat)

        if recording then
            local blink = math.floor(recTime * 2) % 2 == 0
            hudRec.Text = string.format("[ %s REC %02d:%02d ]", blink and "🔴" or "⚫",
                math.floor(recTime / 60), math.floor(recTime % 60))
        else
            hudRec.Text = "[ ⏺ STANDBY ]"
        end
    end
end))
